First, the meal plans look wonderful, but when you go to utilize the grocery list, it doesn’t link up with the meal plan at all. You will make multiple trips back to the grocery store because so many ingredients are missing from the list. Also when you start cooking the recipes, they are incomplete. There are ingredients listed to used, but no instructions on how to use them in the recipe. Lastly, the interface and recording is confusing, and inaccurate. For example. You scan black coffee, you get an A. You scan unsweetened almond milk, it’s an A. You combine coffee with unsweetened almond milk, it’s a D. How does that make sense? Do yourself a favor. Study PCOS yourself. Do not use this app.

title: I wanted this to work. But there are some concerns.
body: Some of the recipes are obviously AI which isn’t bad necessarily, but it would be helpful if someone screened them before adding them. The recipes don't always match the title or photos very well. The title will say something like "Chicken Basil Pasta" but then never mention basil in the entire recipe. When something this simple isn’t screened, it makes me feel like this whole app isn’t actually vetted and is more of a cash grab with info that may not be accurate. (The video lessons are also AI and if there’s no one screening them there’s a chance for misinformation.) Another thing I noticed was when I add a recipe to the log, it only transfers calories and protein but leaves out the carbs and sugar values. If others end up overlooking this, they may be eating more sugar than they realize which could hurt their health/PCOS symptoms. Whenever you first create your profile on the app, it ends up calculating your macros for you and the way it calculates it is different than any other calculators I’ve done. It told me I needed 149g of protein, but whenever I’ve done protein calculators in the past with my body and hormones in mind, I’ve only ever needed anywhere from 95 to 115g. Unused protein turns into sugar, causing issues with insulin resistance. I wanted this app to be the answer for helping handle my PCOS, but the more I use it, all of these little things are adding up and I think there’s a lot of red flags here. I would like to think that whoever developed the app had good intentions, but either way they relied on AI too much and didn’t screen anything. It’s possible to use AI to be more efficient, but this wasn’t it. If someone pays for a HEALTH app, the app shouldn’t be potentially harming their health through the neglect of the developer. Thanks for listening!

Possibly has sugar in it high glycemic index content. Uh it says zero sugar. So I scan again cause the first pic was blurry. It says GOOD. zero sugar zero carbs no additives a good water to add to a pcos diet. Like what the actual heck. Which one is it? title: Helpful Features, Needs Improvement
body: I really like a lot of the features this app offers. The cycle tracking, workouts, water tracking, recipes, and general food logging are all helpful, and I think the app has a lot of potential. However, the food feedback can be discouraging and feels overly restrictive at times. For example, I logged a banana and the app essentially flagged it as a poor choice for PCOS because of its sugar and glycemic impact. I also had a yogurt and received similar feedback. I understand that blood sugar and carbohydrate intake can be relevant to PCOS, but labeling everyday foods like fruit and yogurt as “suboptimal” feels unnecessarily negative. Another issue is that the app does not seem to clearly distinguish between naturally occurring sugar and added sugar when giving its daily sugar feedback. This makes the sugar limit feel misleading, especially when foods like fruit and dairy are contributing to the total. I think the app would be much more helpful if it focused on the overall quality and balance of someone’s diet rather than making individual foods feel “good” or “bad.” I want to use the app to understand my habits and support my health, not feel guilty for eating a banana. Overall, I like the features enough to keep using it, but I hope the nutrition feedback becomes more nuanced and less restrictive. Wish I didn’t spend $70 for the year.

The app automatically requires a subscription when you get into it and the cheapest option is the yearly $69.99 option or its $6.99 a week instead. It doesn’t even give you a clear view of how the app will work or it’s lay out for you to even see if it would be worth trying before you invest a decent chunk of change into. I have spent thousands over the last year managing treatments and infertility for pcos and none of those things lasted so for me this is too much of a financial risk for a shot in the dark. I hope this really works for those who can afford it. I wish they were upfront about subscription costs before you download the app.

I love having everything in one app, the PCOS food scanner is so nice and makes it easy when shopping. I also love how customizable it is, I can add allergies and dietary restrictions which is so helpful because the app also provides PCOS safe recipes!

title: AMAZING APP 💗
body: After finally getting diagnosed with PCOS I felt so lost on what to do and this app makes everything so easy to understand and has given me the guidance that I so needed! The customer service is phenomenal and I can’t recommend this app enough!
Customer service is absolutely amazing!! App really makes me feel seen and heard I’m excited for my new journey

title: Personal Help
body: Not only does that app itself provide personalized help for your PCOS needs, the customer service team does the same. They make everything relational and personalized to help you in every way they can. I have had PCOS for 15 years and sad this app wasn’t available to me until not but I know it will help change so many people’s lives.

title: The best app!!!
body: They give you an option before you delete to tell them what would make you stay for those who really struggle with financial issues and transition periods and finding doctors who will listen it is a great way to be heard and helped!!

title: Definitely worth it
body: The creator of the app is so sincerely sweet, I couldn’t use the app because I’m having financial issues and she made it to where I could use the free trial. I love this app too! I went through before I did this review and it looks so neat and user friendly.

title: Love!!
body: Im loving this app so far, so helpful!!

title: A game changer app for PCOS WARRIORS!!
body: From the moment I downloaded the app I felt seen, supported and empowered

title: So far, so good!
body: So far this app has been lovely to break down into bite sized tidbits easy to digest. I have high hopes!!

title: they’re amazing!!!
body: i’m a full-time student without a job and only purchased a week to give it a try. when i cancelled, they were kind enough to make sure i’d get access for the year. my hormones have been whooping my butt since i was like 12 and this has been so helpful. this is an amazing app and i love everything they’re doing

title: The best app for us PCOS girlies 🌸
body: I absolutely love this app! It is incredibly educational and has helped me feel less alone in dealing with PCOS. Understanding our diagnosis is a journey, and this app provides valuable resources such as food recommendations, tips, and information. I have tried other apps, and this one is, by far, the best. Give it a try—you'll love it too! 💖

title: Amazing App
body: I recently found out I have PCOS and I was so scared since I didn’t know anything about it and also because I am barely 23 years old. Since my budget is low right now, I was able to talk to the administration and they helped me to the point that i got the first year subscription for free and I am so thankful because of that. Today exactly 1 week after I downloaded the app I have lost 5 lbs with the food recipes they provide, who knew that i could loose weight while eating good. I am beyond grateful with this app. It has helped me understand that it is okay to be different and that I am not alone.

title: Amazing!
body: I truly hope and believe this app will be successful and very beneficial for all women strugglin with pcos. The sweetest people run this app so I know that god will allow them success!🩷🩷

title: AMAZING!!
body: Before you can try the app they ask you to pay for a subscription, though not overly expensive, it was still out of my budget at the time. I was able to reach out to support and they helped to provide me with a payment option that worked for my current budget so I could gain the benefits of the app. Well worth it!!

title: don’t hesitate download the app!!!
body: The app is truly amazing! They give you so many recipes based off you’re struggles and you’re eating habits. Not only that, but they also will give you recipes if you’re on an omnivore diet or a vegan diet etc. Overall, they are very inclusive and are there to help you with any struggles you have. The subscription can be a little pricey, but if you reach out to support services, they are very quick to respond and work out a reasonable price with you.

title: Honest
body: I am grateful, this app is amazing and they have best customer service! Definitely worth the it and extremely helpful!

title: Amazing
body: This app is amazing!!! They have recipes ways to keep track of weight and most of all they allow you to get a free trial for those are like me and unable to pay for the app right now. They are kind enough to give you a year free!!! How amazing are they! They are really trying to help us out! And they are quick to get back to you! So amazing love it already.

title: Slayy
body: Just liked the fact that they help you use app even if you can’t afford it right away.

title: Reliable app
body: This app makes my life so much easier even with the PCOS hardship. Fully recommend

title: The meal plans!
body: After getting to be on the app, I have come to find it super helpful. It has meal plans set up for breakfast, lunch and dinner for each day and different videos discussing PCOS and what to expect. I'm hoping I can really tackle this issue through the help of this!!

title: Game Changer for PCOS
body: So excited about this app! The daily recipes are so helpful! Excited to see how this will support my journey.
